newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia to supply TETRA system to Helsinki.
newsitem.headline: Nokia to supply TETRA system to Helsinki.

text.p: Finnish telecommunications group Nokia Oy said on Wednesday it had sealed a deal with Helsinki City Energy Company to test and develop its digital TETRA trunked mobile radio system.
"Nokia Telecommunications and Helsinki City Energy Company have signed an agreement for a development project based on the TETRA system," Nokia said in a statement.
It gave no value for the deal.
The TETRA (Trans European Trunked Radio standard) system is a digital trunked mobile radio solution for professional users and includes both network infrastructure and mobile radios.
"The development project will define and test services in the TETRA system and demonstrate in practice the versatility of the data services connected to the TETRA system," Nokia said.

Beginning in April 1997, Nokia will deliver a complete TETRA system including a switching centre, base stations, network management system and antennas, it said. The network will be put into operation at the beginning of 1998.
Helsinki City Energy will use the system to improve its data and speech communications, Nokia said.
